messages.text: BL-1649 🎵 in progress — The BL-528 claim-idle ladder reads a per-role timeout from swarmforge.conf (QA 90 like the hardender's built-in), logs every reclaim increment with the readings it was decided on, and never counts a role whose agent process is absent or freshly respawned as idle: on 2026-09-19 QA's 80-minute land of BL-1636 crossed the flat 20-minute window, its Claude process died at ~04:00, six reclaims accrued in minutes with no log line each, the daemon bounced QA on top of its own respawn and released the parcel - four reclaims short of kill_all_swarm
